Hi Michael,

Thanks for picking, option 1 it is. The $600 is three units at $200 each on order Shop····, so that is the full difference.

A colleague is applying the $600 as store credit on your account today and will confirm it by email as soon as it is on there. It sits on your account and comes off automatically at checkout on your next order, so there is nothing for you to enter and nothing going back to your card.

Nothing else on the order changes. The three Harlo H15 Dual units, the Miner Duster and the Power Kit all ship together by November 30, 2026, to the (address hidden) address on the order. Your tracking comes to this same address the moment the label is printed.

Sorry again for the extra wait on the ship date, and thanks for sticking with us.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
